notes: 2601.07055 Dr. Zero: out_of_scope confirmed independently. The proposer is trained with HRPO and the solver with GRPO, so every retained change is a weight change; the generated QA pairs are only training data. claim_type is set to component_training and the RS record to self_supervised_signal_engineering/C08 (run convention for proposer–solver co-training: r05b R-Zero, r07b Search Self-play/SPICE, r09b GenEnv). evidence_level and claim_support are set to null, which is the out_of_scope canonical value (both seats wrote task/scoped).

2601.22628 TTCS: out_of_scope confirmed independently. The synthesizer and the solver are both GRPO-updated, and the solver adapts its weights on the very test questions that are then scored (transductive TTT). Identification follows son55 (C08/H22, informational). Same null evidence_level/claim_support correction as above.

2601.07477 JudgeFlow (seat Δ8.75): M → son55 2 and E.causality → son55 1. Final 51.25. M: the Judge is forced to give a full ranking for every failure, it sees the gold answer, and workflows have at most 3 blocks. With so few blocks the localisation advantage over a random-block edit is small, and the paper states no prediction that would separate the two. E.causality: the only isolating comparison, against AFlow, changes three things at once (block abstraction, Judge signal, MCTS replaced by a top-K softmax pool). The Table 1 baselines are quoted 'to keep consistent with prior literature'. There is no Judge-off, random-block or Judge-accuracy control. RS: outside_taxonomy (son55); the blocks are not split by a measured property, so heterogeneous_decomposition does not apply. Domain: H12 + H17.

2601.07641 Test-Time Tool Evolution: final 37.5, below both seats (42.5 / 43.75), reached item by item. E.measurement → sol 1. The appendix case traces contradict the stated 1e-5 tolerance: Case 1 shows 13.738 L/mol for RT/P with P=20 kPa and T=330 K, which is 137.2 L/mol, and 1.23×13.738 is reported as 169.0. Case 2 records 31.6 g against a 33.98 g ground truth as 'correct'. The answer prompt also asks the model to 'simulate' tool execution. E.causality → sol 1 (the central TTE-Zero retention claim has no library-off or per-problem-synthesis control). M → son55 2. E.cost stays not_reported 0 in both seats. Domain: H07 + H30.

2601.11100 ReCreate (seat Δ8.75): G, E.measurement and E.holdout all → sol 2. Final 55.0. G: trajectory-reading neighbours (ExpeL, AWM, Live-SWE-agent, SCOPE) blur the 'metric-only' gap. E.measurement: the Table 2 ReCreate row does not match Table 1 (SWE 60.19 is Django only; DS 77.74 cannot be derived from 77.00/68.63/85.19), and the run convention for table inconsistency (r09b) caps this at 2. E.holdout: the retained Django memory tells the agent to run 'FAIL_TO_PASS tests mentioned in expected_tests.txt', which are the hidden evaluation tests. Whether test-time sandboxes expose that file is not reported. RS → sol generative_process_redesign (sub null; the SICA/Live-SWE convention); the adapt_via_conditioning supporting entry is dropped. Domain: H12 + H02.
